question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

The team plans to

P. flowering and fruit production in apple trees

Q. use the data to get a better understanding of

R. health-promoting compounds of interest and employ

S. biotechnological approaches that could speed up
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• The **correct order** creates a coherent and logical flow of information.
 
• **Q)** "Use the data to get a better understanding of health-promoting compounds of interest" provides the purpose or objective of the team's plan.
 
• **R) **"Employ biotechnological approaches" follows as the next step, indicating the method or strategy the team intends to use.
 
• **S)** "That could speed up flowering and fruit production in apple trees" provides the specific outcome or result that the team aims to achieve.
 
• **P)** Finally, "flowering and fruit production in apple trees" specifies the target area or focus of the team's efforts.
 
• Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'QRSP'.**
